items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you had Mick Goodrick, John Abercrombie… [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Kermit Moore, yeah, who I had gone to school with in Cleveland. That was great.
Gil Goldstein. And then just to round things out at the other extreme, you had Mick Goodrick, John Abercrombie…
